import unittest
import turnstile_counts as app

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_boolean_is_not_a_count(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.sum_counts([3, True, 2, False]), 5)
        self.assertEqual(app.sum_counts([True, True, False]), 0)
    def test_other_scalars(self):
        values = [5, -2, 0, 3.0, '8', None, False]
        self.assertEqual(app.sum_counts(values), 3)
        self.assertEqual(values, [5, -2, 0, 3.0, '8', None, False])
        self.assertIs(type(app.sum_counts([])), int)
        self.assertEqual(app.sum_counts([]), 0)
        self.assertEqual(app.sum_counts([10**20, -1]), 10**20 - 1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
